# Authority Policy

For personal scope, use explicit subject-bound items, then matching session receipts, then evidence explicitly bound to the item. Git cannot create a personal item or identify its owner.

For project and portfolio scope, apply Hub current/registry, v2 session receipts, validation/release evidence, Git activity, then bounded context cues. Lower lanes cannot override higher lanes.

Treat `reviewing`, `draft`, `personal`, and `archived` as non-active. Separate work status from verification state.
